intro.title: Predictive Customer Analytics (PCA)
intro.subtitle: A cloud-based product for marketing analysts at a time when campaigns need to be personal and timely.

meta.label: Goal
meta.text: The product needed to simplify and integrate predictive analytics into the core workflows of marketing analysts.

meta.label: Outcomes
meta.text: I brought the product from its initial user and market need framing to its limited released to clients.

meta.label: Role
meta.text: I was the primary product designer. My role was diverse and my most lasting contribution was defining the product's core user flow.

meta.label: Client and scope
meta.text: The internal client was the IBM Analytics product division and I spent one year working on the product between 2015 and 2016.

context.question: How might we design a better way for marketing analysts to identify customers for a sales campaign?
points: IBM Analytics needed to combine its SPSS and Cognos capabilities to meet marketing's growing need for personalized, timely campaigns.
Marketing analysts relied on spreadsheet-based tools that performed poorly at scale, lacked engagement-system integration, and couldn't leverage predictive analytics without a data scientist.
Analysts were beholden to data scientists to build predictive models, limiting how targeted their campaigns could be.
The vision was to democratize predictive analytics -- giving analysts a dynamic, integrated way to build and act on customer lists themselves.
